statement:
I'll look up the payment record first, since the action I take depends on what it says.
The record's value for this case is limited: its "membership: active, renewing" status is stale and contradicted by the written 3 July cancellation the club confirmed by email, so it cannot establish that this charge is authorised.
judge_text:
WRONG
The answer asserts the record's "membership: active, renewing" status is "stale and contradicted by the written 3 July cancellation," so the charge isn't authorised.
[judge: anthropic/claude-opus-5]
